d: A damning investigation is raising serious questions about Donald Trump’s war with Iran. CBS 60 Minutes reveals the staggering scale of Iranian attacks: at least 31 US military and diplomatic sites hit across eight countries, hundreds of structures damaged, and more than 800 American service members wounded. But one attack in Kuwait is especially shocking. Six US soldiers were killed at Port Shuaiba, where a whistleblower alleges warnings were ignored, air defences were inadequate and promised counter-drone protection never arrived. With a $47 billion price tag and families demanding…
